raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Program (Phase 1 Start)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Postpartum return: safe, progressive strength, core activation, gentle loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & safety":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bodyweight_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Gentle core activation":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x15 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mrep 0
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Low load endurance":
        warmup:
          marching 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          side_plank 2 x 15 seconds per side
  WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive loading":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core foundations":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x15 seconds per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Mobility & light conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1 minute per side
  WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Stability & symmetry":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          sumo_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Breath & core control":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x15 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated_forward_fold 2 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Light strength cadence":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobilization 2 minutes
  WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 1 recap & readiness":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Light core + mobility":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1 minute per side
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Friday training 40m "End of Phase 1 readiness":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 1 minute per side

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive loading & breath work":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core patterning":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 seconds per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 4x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 2 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Functional integration":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 4x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1 minute per side
  WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Load progression":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1 minute per side
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Stability fundamentals":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1 minute per side
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Mobility & conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walking_lunge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 1 minute per side
  WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Volume build":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core reclaim":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x25 seconds per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1 minute per side
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Return to light cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 1 minute per side
  WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 2 capstone":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobilization 2 minutes

Notes:
- All exercises use bodyweight or minimal resistance suitable for early postpartum return. Avoid ab-specific crunches or high spinal load until cleared.
- RPE targets approximate effort; adjust by mother’s feedback and OB guidance.
- If any abdominal doming or leakage occurs, stop exercise and consult clinician.
- Ensure hydration, warm lighting, and safe space for home practice.
